items.lede: Google's Pixel Tag lets you track lost items with your Android device, similar to Apple's AirTag.
items.title: Pixel Tag, Google’s $30 Android-ready answer to Apple’s AirTag, is now available

items.lede: After years of third-party Android trackers from companies like Samsung, Motorola, and Pebblebee, Google's Pixel Tag is now available for purchase. First announced in August, the Pixel Tag is designed to work with Google's tracking network and app that was renamed the Find Hub last year. The Pixel Tag is priced similar to Apple's AirTag […]
items.title: Google’s Pixel Tag tracker is now available
